issue.title: Narrow cabinet pick overlay: shed the ▸/▾ state glyphs before nouns truncate to one letter at 420 px

task_type_fields.proposal:
At 420 px the armed `_` footer overlay (bob-plugins
`plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/122-walker-footer-host.js` `walkerFooterOverlayFit` plus
the `Walker footer overlay` CSS region) correctly sheds `esc` first and keeps the
`▤ Cabinets` label and the keycaps whole. With four cabinets, though, each noun gets
about 6 px and renders as its first letter ("1 A▾ 2 N▾ …"). Proposal (bob-cli-qq.10.4
note #3): add a fit step that sheds the ▸/▾ state glyphs after `esc` and before nouns
truncate, so short nouns stay readable. Optionally abbreviate nouns only as the last
step. Extend `scripts/preview-walker-footer.cjs` and the
`420px cabinet overlay sheds esc …` runner self-test with a four-cabinet narrow
fixture. Evidence: the go-3/go-4 `footer-*-narrow-armed` captures in
file:explicit:36ae0363a0a42f0422dbe45c.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The shipped contract (label and keycaps never clip, esc sheds first, nouns truncate with an ellipsis) holds and acceptance recorded GO, so this readability refinement goes beyond the cabinets epic's acceptance bars.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-qq.10.4 (note #3) and triaged by the bob-cli-qq.10 land agent: a UX refinement beyond the cabinets overlay contract, which already holds.
